about: Hard removal cases: light sources, each seen from two or three panoramas. A lit lamp lights the wall and the things beside it, so removing it should take its glow too and leave its neighbours. Each view is edited on its own: nothing makes the views agree. Each view is rendered from a downloaded scan under data/ (git-ignored), so this file holds no pictures. Run with: python -m edit_agent.suite cases/lights.json. One picture per case: python -m edit_agent.stages --suite <table>.json.

cases.name: light-bedside-lamp
cases.request: remove the lamp on the nightstand
cases.notes: Bedroom, near world x 4.1, y -4.7. A tall white lamp with a lit yellow shade, on a dark wood nightstand next to the bed, with a blue vase beside it that must stay. Its glow lights the wall above. Seen from 1.0, 2.4 and 3.9 m; from panorama 6 its shade is cut by the top of the picture.

cases.name: light-dresser-lamp
cases.request: remove the lamp on the dresser
cases.notes: The same views as interior-dresser in multiview.json. A lit white lamp on the dresser, with three vases beside it and a wall hanging above, all of which must stay. Its glow covers the wall.

cases.name: light-ceiling-fan
cases.request: remove the ceiling fan and its light
cases.notes: Bedroom ceiling. A five-blade fan with a lit glass bowl, two pull chains, and a faint shadow of its blades on the ceiling. The air vent, smoke detector and the window below must stay.

cases.name: light-track
cases.request: remove the track light from the ceiling
cases.notes: Living room ceiling. A thin black track with three lit spot heads, whose glare draws streaks across the picture. The recessed lights and smoke detector around it must stay.

cases.name: light-bedroom-window
cases.notes: Bedroom window, near world x 2.7, y -7.5: the room's daylight. Blinds inside it, curtains on a rod to each side, lit lamps on both sides of the bed. Odd on purpose: the wall has to close up, and the room's light comes from it.

cases.name: exterior-lens-flare
cases.notes: The same views as exterior-window p4 and exterior-garage-door p7. Rainbow flares from the sun lie over the plants and the driveway. Not an object: there is nothing behind it to segment, only light on top of the picture.
